_readme: Calendar dates for the community spreadsheet's matches.
The sheet records NO dates: every series is placed only by its tab
(region + stage) and its card label (Week N | Day N | Game N). This file
turns that position into an ESTIMATED calendar date so the Tiers page
can filter by an as-of date and a date range. Every date produced from
it is published with dateMethod 'schedule-estimate' and is labelled
'estimated' on the page. It is never written back into the imported
records and never shown as a VOD-verified fact.
How a date is computed (pipeline/external_sheet/tiers.py):
* `weeks["N"]` is the date of Day 1 of Week N; Day D is that date
plus (D - 1) * dayStep days.
* an event with no weeks (international LANs) uses `days["D"]`.
* a week missing from `weeks` is extrapolated 7 days from the last
listed week before it.
`confidence`: 'window' = the stage's first and last dates come from a
published schedule (Blizzard viewers' guides, Liquipedia via search,
esports.gg, owtics.gg; see `source`), the weeks between are spaced
weekly; 'estimate' = no published dates were found, the window is a
guess from the season's rhythm. Fix any date here and run
`python3 pipeline/sheet_sync.py rebuild`.
Gathered 2026-11-02. Liquipedia itself was not reachable from the
build environment, so its dates were read through search results.
